scientific_queries.note: Direct test of the tissue-in-distribution qualifier, contrasting known-tissue and held-tissue holdouts in one run.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the round puts both holdouts side by side and both the qualifier and R119's reversal fall.
the_qualifier_is_wrong: pathway gives +5.61 pp with a known tissue and +8.12 pp with an unseen tissue, so the increment does not depend on the tissue being in distribution

why_R119_was_wrong.design: it used the sparse boolean flag with k equal to 20 and its combo arm carried the tissue block
two_problems: the sparse criterion has no resolution, with identity at 1.30 percent against a minimum detectable effect of 1.02 pp
the tissue block's columns are dead under tissue holdout, so the reversal was about a dead block plus an unresolvable criterion
why_R119_was_wrong.consequence: C90 is retracted and the qualifier is removed from the condition statement

a_clean_internal_control.observation: in the held-tissue pool the tissue block delivers exactly +0.0000 [-0.0104, +0.0102]
a_clean_internal_control.why_it_matters: a block whose columns never appear in training must contribute nothing, and the apparatus reproduces that exactly, while the pathway block in the same pool gives +8.12 pp
a_clean_internal_control.reading: the two blocks are cleanly separated and the pipeline can detect a dead block

the_stable_picture.statement: when both drugs are unseen the pathway annotation adds 4.7 to 8.6 pp, and whether the cell or the tissue has been seen does not change this

the_meta_lesson.span: the confusion from R119 to R124 traces back to one criterion choice in R119
the_meta_lesson.mechanism: the sparse criterion mixed cases where identity sits at chance with cases where identity is far above chance, so each later round split an already-wrong table
the_meta_lesson.new_standing_rule: before declaring a block useless or a conclusion reversed, report that criterion's minimum detectable effect and how far identity sits above chance

limits: dense criterion only, a quartile rather than a clinical endpoint
magnitudes range from 4.7 to 8.6 pp across the six estimates
only three tissues, one held out per split
retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim; no meta-learning or RSI
